sources: https://www.blm.gov/visit/tailrace-camp-area (read 2026-11-20): 'The Tailrace Camp area features three campsites with fire rings and a vault toilet. This campground is wedged between Fontenelle Reservoir and Seedskadee National Wildlife Refuge, and so makes a fantastic site for birding, fishing, or non-motorized water sports.'; managed by Kemmerer Field Office, 307-828-4500; directions 'Located 1/4 mile south of Fontenelle Reservoir on the east side of the Green River. To access camp area, travel east on Highway 372 for one mile, cross the Green River Bridge, then immediately turn north for four miles. Turn west before the dam to the river and go one mile further.'; page map marker -110.0609, 42.0244 'Tailrace Camp Area'; no fee, season or stay-limit line on the page

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (1.2 km, 500 m, 350 m and z18 frames): the BLM/Google point is on the EAST bank of the Green River below the dam's outlet works, at a junction above an open gravel bank strip (10-30 m wide between the tree clumps and the water's straight, apparently armoured edge); the river there is ~90 m wide; a small structure (likely the vault toilet) ~40 m east of the point; individual fire-ring sites not resolvable. The stored pin 42.0250,-110.0651 is on the WEST (south) bank at an open gravel flat by the outlet pool, ~350 m WNW of the BLM point across the river
